Working Relationship  
Carmen and I crossed paths through shared projects at HealthInsight Analytics, where she collaborated on predictive analytics initiatives. Our interactions were informal but meaningful, centered on problem-solving and iterative improvements. She consistently approached challenges with curiosity and a knack for distilling complex problems into actionable steps.  

Day-to-Day Observations  
Carmen’s routine involved refining models for patient risk stratification, where she balanced statistical rigor with clinical relevance. She frequently leveraged Python and scikit-learn to build scalable solutions, often iterating rapidly based on stakeholder feedback. Her work on A/B testing frameworks for treatment protocols showcased her ability to translate abstract hypotheses into measurable outcomes. She also streamlined data workflows, reducing manual effort in feature engineering by standardizing data pipelines.  

Standout Moments  
One notable project involved optimizing a diabetes management model using XGBoost. Carmen identified key variables overlooked by prior teams, improving prediction accuracy by 12% without sacrificing interpretability. Her attention to detail ensured results aligned with clinical guidelines, earning cross-functional buy-in. She also mentored junior analysts, sharing frameworks for debugging models and prioritizing ethical considerations in data use.  

Recommendation  
Carmen’s strength lies in her ability to merge technical precision with real-world impact. She thrives in collaborative environments, bringing both analytical depth and a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. Her work ethic—marked by persistence and a commitment to clarity—makes her a reliable and influential contributor. I’d welcome the opportunity to see her apply these qualities to new challenges.
